critical_mismatches: Adds erroneous qualifier 'russische Rosendahl' (introduces incorrect nationality/attribute not in reference).
'rot geschmierte Käse' vs reference 'rot geschnittene Käse' (alters the described cheese characteristic).

Several supplier/place names are garbled (reference mentions 'Messier Champagner' / 'Tourlier' and 'Brückerei Nebel'; candidate renders these as 'messias champrenat'/'der tullier' and 'brokkerei nebel'), changing proper names.
Some other proper names slightly altered (e.g. 'Backers Heimes' vs candidate 'Backes und Heimes'), which can confuse identification of partners.
rationale: The candidate preserves the main factual content and numbers (20,000 t/yr milk products; ~1,100 t/yr cheese; ~30 km to Rosendahl; milk flow via Gronau; external warehouse near Epe ~6 km; use of external cutter, Gouda block production, collaboration with Passendale, etc.). However, several misrendered proper names and at least one incorrect adjectival insertion ('russische') and a change in cheese description ('geschmierte' vs 'geschnittene') materially change meaning in places. These name and descriptor errors are the primary sources of reduced semantic fidelity.
